acceptance: A red-first test through the real seat health reader: a pane with the wait note gives waiting-on-lock, and a pane with no note and no output gives blocked.
wave status prints the waiting label for such a seat.
fix: In go/internal/bridge/panestream/seathealth.go, recognize the single-flight wait note in the pane stream and report the seat as waiting on the lock, with the wait time. Keep blocked for a seat with no such note.
summary: wave status labels an agy seat as blocked while its lane waits at the host verification lock. The label hides the cause. The wait note '[verify] single-flight: waiting ... for the host verification lock' is printed to the pane after 5 s and every 60 s (internal/verifylock/verifylock.go).
title: Seat health shows an agy seat that waits on the verification lock as waiting, not blocked
